Contents: the v60 win64 tarball tree with bin/ppcx64.exe swapped -- a COMPILER-BINARY-ONLY refresh.  Every other bin/
member is byte-identical to v60 (and v59).  UNITS ARE STILL THE v52 SET (vibepascal-v52-win64-units.tar.gz): no RTL
change, no package change, no PPU format change.  auto-update.bat can take this ~3.4 MB bin tarball alone.

WHAT CHANGED IN v61 -- TWO DEFECTS, ONE CAUSE, BOTH ONLY WHEN THE WITH WAS NOT THE FIRST STATEMENT OF ITS BLOCK
  tblocknode.simplify splices a compiler-built statement list (the hidden pieces of a with statement: prefix temp
  create, its assignment, the body, the temp deletes) into the enclosing begin..end when the with is not the first
  statement there.  Since v59 numbers and releases interface temps per source statement, every spliced piece became
  a statement of its own:
    * "with Make.o do begin ... end" (Make returns a COM interface, .o is the raw object): the assignment piece
      released the interface BEFORE the body ran, so the body worked on a freed object.  Present in v59 AND v60.
    * "with Make do begin ... end": the prefix temps were deleted under marks newer than their own stamp and
      leaked until routine exit (v59).  GOD's 407ef9bb3a (v60) closed this half and stays in.
  v61 never merges a compiler-built list into a source block (a nested begin..end still may be: its statements are
  real ones).  Nothing is released earlier than the end of the with statement, and nothing later.

VERIFIED ON THESE EXACT BYTES, under wine64 on lazdev, this exe against the v52 units:
  * tests/test/tintfwithprefix1.pp (new, 62 corners): checks=62 fails=0 created=56 destroyed=56 live=0 at -O- and -O2.
    The v60 exe (17497551...) prints 5 FAIL lines on the same program, the v59 exe (bec75bee...) 16.
  * tests/test/tintfstmttemp1.pp 32/32, tintfstmttemp2.pp 28/28 created=27 destroyed=27 live=0.
  * 17 further spliced-shape corners (raw .o after an inline var, after a preceding call, nested, two in a row,
    exit out of the body, main block): 17/17; the v60 exe fails 5 of them, the v59 exe 7.
  wine is NOT Windows.  v59 ran on native Windows (2026-09-17); v60 and v61 have not yet.
